title: Dan Campbell: Jared Goff is massively underrated, reminds me of Drew Brees

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Jared Goff is massively underrated, reminds me of Drew Brees
sources.description: Lions head coach Dan Campbell was briefly Drew Brees' teammate in New Orleans, and was on the Saints' coaching staff for the last five seasons of Brees' career.
